visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing a pink and white plaid coat over a white blouse with a large bow, sits on a cream-colored couch. She smiles broadly, gesturing with her hands while snowflake and star graphics float around her. The background is a bright, white-toned indoor space featuring a decorated Christmas tree with silver ornaments and white stockings. (2) The woman presents a white and pink rectangular gift box with the logo 'AiAO' on top. She opens the box to reveal a bottle of skincare lotion and several pink sheet mask packets. She holds the items toward the camera with a cheerful expression, while animated hearts and glowing gift icons appear around her torso. (3) A close-up shot shows a hand pulling a white sheet mask out of a pink packet. The scene cuts to a demonstration where a different person's face is shown wearing the white mask. Fingers gently tap the mask to ensure adhesion. The lighting remains bright and even, emphasizing the wet, glistening texture of the mask's essence. (4) The woman returns to the screen, holding a white and gold bottle. She pumps a white cream onto the back of her hand and rubs it in with her fingers. A split-screen comparison appears, showing two hands side-by-side to demonstrate a brighter, more hydrated skin tone on one hand. (5) The woman holds the entire gift box again, smiling and pointing at the camera. She leans forward, her facial expressions becoming more exaggerated and playful. The scene concludes with a fast-paced zoom-in on the woman holding the box, surrounded by radiating 'action lines' graphics, as she maintains a highly energetic and inviting posture.
